status: Independent exploratory design after the daily channel and breakout-horizon diagnostics failed. All years reused; no unused-period claim.
budget: One fixed design, no RSI, trend, stop or exit parameter search
hypothesis: Brief contrarian entries aligned with the broad trend may exploit pullback recovery without paying months of funding or chasing weak breakout labels

strategy.name: daily_rsi2_reversion
strategy.trend: Daily close above EMA200 for long; below EMA200 for short
strategy.long_entry: Completed daily RSI2 below 10, close above EMA200, flat
strategy.short_entry: Completed daily RSI2 above 90, close below EMA200, flat
strategy.execution: Market at next 5m open after signal close; no same-close fill
strategy.stop: Fixed 2 daily ATR14 from signal close, rounded outward, active on entry subbar
strategy.long_exit: Completed daily RSI2 above 70; next open
strategy.short_exit: Completed daily RSI2 below 30; next open
strategy.timeout: Exit at next open when ten full UTC days from entry have elapsed
strategy.busy_signals: Discard; no same-signal reverse, stacking or pyramiding
strategy.fibonacci: Absent; no assumed benefit without a controlled comparison

execution.funding: Actual Binance settlements on carried quantity, using five-minute opening traded price as mark proxy
execution.entry_gap: Submission sizes freeze; actual-fill risk warnings are recorded, never described as guaranteed loss caps

publication: Every outcome is published. A candidate meeting the declared exploratory gates can proceed to a visibly experimental Pine implementation; native and prospective verification remain outstanding. No gate relaxation after outcomes.
